invalidated: The earlier principal-submatrix isolation diagnostic cannot be promoted as the unchanged ordered-event projector theorem.
Finite action-Cauchy behavior and bounded sampled S2 correction norms do not by themselves prove strong-graph closure or the nonlinear continuum radius.
claim_boundary: N48 and N64 source-corrected states are retained-action linear diagnostic probes, not complete-child roots.
